title: DeepEyes: Incentivizing Visual Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning
method: Interleaved text-image crop-and-zoom trajectories trained with outcome-oriented reinforcement learning and format/tool rewards
evidence: Defines active visual perception as a learnable trajectory
Filters data to retain examples where visual tools have plausible utility
Reports improvements on high-resolution visual question answering
limitations: Outcome gains do not by themselves identify tool-induced causal gains
Tool-use formatting and additional compute are confounders
Medical complex reasoning is not the central evaluation setting
transfer_decision: Adopt selective crop trajectories and utility filtering; require same-checkpoint tool-free controls and tool-harm accounting.
